messages:
maya: Quick Q — where's the best saved search for multi-org logs on model=zenith route=/generate when we're troubleshooting a 5xx spike? Need link + a saved query we can reuse.

alex: Try this in logsearch to narrow it down:
```
service:inference route:"/generate" model:zenith status:[500 TO 599] region:(eu OR ap-sg) | sort timestamp desc
```

alex: I recommend saving it as `ops/zenith-multiorg-5xx` and pinning to the production ops dashboard.

sam: When hunting, add org filters if you want per-customer counts, e.g. `org:acme OR org:zephyr` so you don't mix telemetry.

ops-bot: Dashboard (prod ops): https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ops/prod-inference?view=routes&panel=5

maya: Thanks. Also — alerting: should we tune the 5xx alert or create a route-specific one? P95 latency was fine but 5xx count jumped.

tess: For 5xx spikes I usually create a ratio alert: error_count/req_count > 0.02 for 5m. For route-level, do the same but scoped to `route:"/generate"` and region.

alex: EU baseline for this route is ~0.5% errors. If you're seeing >2% for 5m that's worthy of a page.

maya: Can someone save the query? I don't have rights to pin dashboards.

alex: I'll save and share. Naming: `ops/zenith-eu-ap-5xx-by-org` and share with eng-sre team.

ops-bot: Saved search created by alex: https://logs.redwood.internal/saved/ops/zenith-eu-ap-5xx-by-org

maya: Perfect, added to the incident runbook. Will use that view during the oncall rotation.

sam: FYI if you need model-version splits add `kv:model_version` to the query and group by it.

maya: Good call. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Note: saved query has two quick variants — one with `status:[500 TO 599]` and one with `error:true` (for non-HTTP internal errors). Use the `error:true` view when looking for infra vs. upstream issues.
